up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for the organism Oryctolagus cuniculus, including the substrate structure, substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion, pathway key, and enzyme name.
sql:
WITH substrates AS (
  SELECT
    met.met_id,
    met.drug_record_id,
    met.metabolite_record_id,
    met.pathway_key,
    met.enzyme_name,
    met.met_conversion,
    met.tax_id,
    sub_str.standard_inchi AS substrate_inchi,
    sub_str.canonical_smiles AS substrate_smiles,
    sub_mol.chembl_id AS substrate_chembl_id,
    sub_rec.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name,
    parent_mol.chembl_id AS parent_chembl_id,
    parent_rec.compound_name AS parent_compound_name
  FROM metabolism met
  LEFT JOIN compound_records sub_rec ON met.substrate_record_id = sub_rec.record_id
  LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary sub_mol ON sub_rec.molregno = sub_mol.molregno
  LEFT JOIN compound_structures sub_str ON sub_mol.molregno = sub_str.molregno
  LEFT JOIN compound_records parent_rec ON met.drug_record_id = parent_rec.record_id
  LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary parent_mol ON parent_rec.molregno = parent_mol.molregno
  WHERE met.tax_id = 9986
  ORDER BY met.met_id ASC
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
  substrate_inchi AS substrate_structure,
  substrate_compound_name,
  parent_compound_name,
  met_conversion AS metabolic_conversion,
  pathway_key AS pathway,
  enzyme_name AS enzyme
FROM substrates;
